description:
The claim deadline and days left for a company's data-breach or privacy settlement, plus the opt-out and objection deadlines and the final approval hearing date, each as read off the official site.

Example questions:
- "When is the deadline for the Columbia settlement?"
- "Is it too late to file the DaVita claim?"
- "How many days left to claim the La Jolla Group settlement?"

company.description: The company or organization named on the letter or in the news. Nothing else about the person.

name: settlement_claim_deadline
title: When is the deadline to file a claim in the X settlement?
